def go(n):
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    k = 1
    cnt = 1
    while k * 10 + 1 < n:
        k = k * 10 + 1
        cnt += 1
    return min(go(n % k) + n // k * cnt, go((k * 10 + 1 - n) % k) + (cnt + 1) + (k * 10 + 1 - n) // k * cnt)

def solve():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    print(go(n))
